summary:
Jon Moritsugu is an American underground filmmaker and musician whose low-budget films parody popular genres through absurdist comedy, abrasive editing, vivid colors and punk-influenced sound. He studied semiotics and critical theory at Brown University, where his 1987 thesis film, *Der Elvis*, was later restored by Anthology Film Archives.

His features include *My Degeneration* (1989), *Hippy Porn* (1991), *Terminal USA* (1993), *Mod Fuck Explosion* (1994), *Fame Whore* (1997), *Scumrock* (2002) and *Pig Death Machine* (2013). Several won awards at underground film festivals. *Terminal USA*, an ITVS-funded sitcom parody, sparked political controversy and aired in more than 200 US cities. Moritsugu’s work has screened at festivals and museums, and he received Creative Capital’s Moving Image award in 2001.

He frequently collaborates with actor and co-writer Amy Davis. Their 2011 music video for TV on the Radio received a 2012 Grammy nomination. Moritsugu played in No-No Boy and formed the band Low on High with Davis. His memoir, *SKULLFUCK*, was published in 2022; *Numbskull Revolution* is listed as a 2026 film.
